name: Personal Teleportation
description: Instantly relocates the user (and whatever they're wearing/carrying) to a familiar nearby spot on the same plane, on command.

mechanics.text: On activation, the user (and everything worn/carried) teleports to a location within this record's own featureParams.range feet, on the same plane. Distinct from feat.planar-travel (crosses planes entirely) and Crucible's own feat.teleport (a monster's passive teleport-as-part-of-its-move, not a user-activated item power).
